encoding_probe_source:
from pathlib import Path
from fontTools.ttLib import sfnt
from fontTools.ttLib.sfnt import SFNTReader,SFNTWriter
import hashlib,json,sys,time
import zopfli.zlib
source=Path(sys.argv[1]); output=Path(sys.argv[2]); record=Path(sys.argv[3])
start=time.perf_counter()
sfnt.compress=lambda data,level=6: zopfli.zlib.compress(data,numiterations=1)
with source.open('rb') as original, output.open('wb') as target:
    reader=SFNTReader(original)
    writer=SFNTWriter(target,len(reader.tables),reader.sfntVersion,flavor='woff',flavorData=reader.flavorData)
    for tag in sorted(reader.keys(),key=lambda tag:reader.tables[tag].offset):
        tick=time.perf_counter();writer[tag]=reader[tag]
        print(str(tag),round(time.perf_counter()-tick,3),flush=True)
    writer.close()
with source.open('rb') as a,output.open('rb') as b:
    old,new=SFNTReader(a),SFNTReader(b)
    assert set(old.keys())==set(new.keys())
    changed=[str(tag) for tag in old.keys() if old[tag]!=new[tag]]
    assert not changed,changed
    tables={str(tag):hashlib.sha256(old[tag]).hexdigest() for tag in old.keys()}
    assert vars(old.flavorData)==vars(new.flavorData)
result={'source':str(source),'output':str(output),'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'before_bytes':source.stat().st_size,'after_bytes':output.stat().st_size,'changed_tables':changed,'table_sha256':tables,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
record.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
